Now fix plugins.ts. The fixes there are:
1. Replace the inline `assertBoardOrgAccessCtx` and `assertBoardCtx` helpers with direct calls to `assertBoardOrgAccess(ctx)` / `assertBoard(ctx)`.
2. Move `assertInstanceAdmin` into handlers that used to rely on Express middleware wrappers.
3. Clean up the now-redundant Express middleware wrappers.

The `plugins.ts` file still has many genuine Express-only routes (SSE stream, scoped API middleware, webhook delivery) that are tagged `TODO(cloudflare): SSE` or `TODO(cloudflare): scoped API` — those stay.
